statements.impact_statement: Ubuntu USN-8996-1 (https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8996-1) fixes CVE-2026-109518 in 3.2.1ubuntu0.1 for Ubuntu 26.04. This Compose builder installs the official amd64 apt SHA256 0de729b8fe0e1c67c04e8e8d5bd6e0420dbd47f75b93f0b71c8e740edc2d5ffc and libapt-pkg7.0 SHA256 94e5d41303265b66af0f8c70ade18bfb77260ad286edee6c8045faddef82b94c before its first APT operation. The release gate checks the actual builder dpkg/package identities and permits only this exact native-Trivy fixed delta; the raw report remains retained. The CGO-disabled released executable contains no Ubuntu package payload.
